<script>
(function(){
  async function loadOxyContacts(){
    try{
      var r=await fetch('/api/oxygen/status'); var j=await r.json();
      window._oxyContacts=Array.isArray(j.contacts)?j.contacts.map(function(c){return {id:c.id,name:c.name};}):[];
      if(typeof renderCfg==='function'&&document.getElementById('cfg-grid'))renderCfg();
    }catch(e){}
  }
  window._reloadOxyContacts=loadOxyContacts;
  setTimeout(loadOxyContacts,1500);
})();
</script>
